title: Docs portal `/docs…` in an app-less variant of the app shell on desktop: neutral 「文档」 head with the app switcher, docs tree in the sidebar, no top bar, every URL kept (#37150 item 2)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

Filing gate ③ — maintainer ruling. Source: #37150 item 2, ruling recorded on #37150 (comment 7151721568). The maintainer, verbatim, in seat repo:objectstack#4's session: 「B：做一个不属于任何应用的外壳变体（推荐）」. It implements ruling A on #36107 phase 3 (record 7142354097: 「统一成一种外观，两个入口和旧链接都保留」).

**Business reason.** After PR #37193, from 768 px up an app's manual (`/apps/APP/docs…`) draws in the app shell: sidebar, no top bar. The docs portal (`/docs…`), which names no app, still draws in Home's frame with the docs bar (`DefaultHomeLayout variant="docs"`, `ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx:228-235`, route at `:441`). A reader moving between the two entry points sees two different frames for the same documents, and the portal is the last desktop page that still draws a top bar. The shell cannot simply be mounted around it: `ConsoleLayout` is app-scoped, and guessing an app for an app-less route is what objectui#4280 refused for `/forms/:name`.

**Change.** On desktop (≥ 768 px), `/docs…` renders in an app-less variant of the same AppShell and sidebar frame:
- the sidebar's usual chrome (search, bell, account footer), and no top bar;
- in place of an app's menu head, a neutral 「文档」 head with the app switcher;
- the sidebar body is the docs tree, with 「全部文档」 first, reusing the docs-navigation slot PR #37193 added (`sidebarDocsNavSlot`);
- no app is guessed, and nothing is written into shared navigation state (last app, current app);
- every URL form stays as it is. That includes the old forms #37193 pins (book NAME, book NAME/DOC, a doc name that is also a book name, canonical SLUG/DOC) and their redirects (ADR-0046 §6).
Phone is unchanged.

**Two stages (maintainer, verbatim, recorded on #37150: 「docs 新外壳先画设计图给我看」).**
1. **Design first.** The cloud session produces mockups of the app-less shell: the real AppShell and sidebar components on a scratch branch, screenshotted, or a static page. Views:
   - the desktop `/docs` landing;
   - one doc open;
   - the 「文档」 head with the app switcher open;
   - the sidebar collapsed;
   - phone, unchanged.

   Each view gets a one-line note on what differs from the app shell. The images or links go to seat repo:objectstack#4, which puts them in front of the maintainer.
2. **Build** only after the maintainer approves the design on this card. Until then there is no implementation PR for this card.

**Acceptance (stage 2).**
- At 768 and 1440 px, `/docs`, `/docs/<book>` and `/docs/<book>/<name>` show the app-less shell with the 「文档」 head and the docs tree, and no top bar.
- At phone width the current portal is unchanged, as the control.
- Old URL forms resolve as before.
- Opening `/docs` cold does not change the last-used app.
- Pins at desktop and phone width; an ablation of the variant switch turns them red.

Grade: area:ux · Task · the last desktop page still drawing the top bar, and a second frame for the same documents · p2 (epic grade, as #37150). Size L (new app-shell structure).
Mode: `mode:cloud`. It runs in its own cloud session, per the maintainer's rule for large cards.
Reader: zone a4-C of seat repo:objectstack#4 dispatches stage 1 when a slot is free and stage 2 once PR #37193 lands, because the two share `ConsoleLayout.tsx`, `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`, `sidebarDocsNavSlot.tsx` and the docs pages.
Stage 2 is blocked by #37193 and by the maintainer's approval of the design. Stage 1 (mockups on a scratch branch, no PR) is not blocked and does not conflict with #37193.
Dedupe: `"docs portal" app-less shell` (open objectstack issues) → 1 hit (#37150, the parent card). `docs app shell variant` → 7, none on the portal frame. `DefaultHomeLayout docs` → 2 (#37150, #36107).
